chapters.title: Reverse inorder with a running sum
chapters.code:
def convert_bst(root):
    running = 0

    def walk(node):
        nonlocal running
        if node is None:
            return
        walk(node.right)
        running += node.val
        node.val = running
        walk(node.left)

    walk(root)
    return root
